steps.calibration: fit using source validation or nested source-only out-of-fold predictions
steps.categorical_encoding: source-train fitted with frozen unknown category
steps.feature_selection: source-train/validation only; freeze before target access
steps.imputation: source-train median for numeric; source-train explicit missing/unknown token for text/categorical
steps.normalization: source-train mean/std, applied unchanged; zero variance removed from source train
steps.resampling: source train only; never validation or target
steps.target_zscore: PROHIBITED in primary protocol: TARGET mean/std is transductive covariate adaptation even without labels
steps.text: source-train vocabulary and IDF; sparse and uncentered
steps.threshold: predeclare 0.5 and any operational threshold from source validation only

transductive_secondary: A separately labelled, preregistered sensitivity analysis may fit unsupervised target covariate normalization; it must never use target labels or be conflated with strict inductive CPDP.
